intro: Grelin Whitebeard's Journal is a personal field notebook kept by the dwarf scout Grelin Whitebeard in Coldridge Valley. Containing critical notes on local Frostmane troll activity, the journal was stolen by the chieftain Grik'nir the Cold and dragged into the troll cave in Coldridge Valley.

p: While observing the aggressive movements of the Frostmane trolls near Coldridge Valley, Grelin Whitebeard diligently recorded his findings in this leatherbound notebook. The document contains his raw field observations regarding the strength, organization, and threat level posed by the indigenous winter trolls. However, during a confrontation or ambush, the journal was snatched away by Grik'nir the Cold—a heavily marked troll leader—forcing Grelin to recruit passing adventurers to delve into the troll cave and wrest it back before his report could be finalized.
